messages:
Emily (AE): Quick question — customer wants POC credits (2 months free Dedicated) to roll into their annual commit if they sign within 60 days. Are we ok crediting POC usage toward the first-year reserved capacity?
Maria (Sales-Eng): Need clarity on how we proration that. Do we apply a dollar-for-dollar credit or a % of monthly commit?
Kevin (Finance): Short answer: we can credit, but only as a one-time dollar credit applied to the first invoice. We don't do month-for-month proration that changes the committed monthly SKU.
Emily (AE): Got it. Customer specifically asked: "Can we count the 2 months of reserved capacity during POC toward our 12-month commit so we pay less on month 1?"
Kevin (Finance): We can apply the POC credit against the committed ARR up to the credit value. Example: commit is $120k/yr ($10k/mo). If POC credit equals $15k, we reduce the first invoice by $15k. We do NOT reduce the term length.
Maria (Sales-Eng): Customer also asked about support tiering during POC — they want Gold support during POC but are expecting Standard post-commit unless they pay delta. Can we set temporary support to Gold for the trial and auto-switch to Standard unless they opt-up?
Sam (Solutions): That's operationally fine. We can enable a temporary support tier flag on the contract for trial window. Need legal signoff on auto-switch clause + a clear churn path.
Alex (Legal): We can add a clause like: ```If Customer signs a 12-month Commitment within 60 days of POC, Redwood will apply a one-time credit in the amount of POC fees to the first invoice. Support tier during POC is provided at Gold level; post-POC the Support Tier will revert to Standard unless Customer signs the Support Addendum within 30 days of execution.``` Keep that language.
Emily (AE): Perfect. One more: customer worried about a "scaling surcharge" if they exceed committed GPU utilization by >120% during burst months. They want that capped for first 3 months.
Kevin (Finance): We can offer an exception: cap overage multiplier to 1.25x (instead of 1.5x) for the first 3 billing cycles post-commit only. Needs Deal Desk approval if it's outside standard rate card.
Maria (Sales-Eng): I'll submit to Deal Desk. Required docs: POC usage report, proposed cap, legal clause text, and signed SOW.
Emily (AE): Thanks — cc @Kevin and @Alex on the Deal Desk ticket. Can someone confirm we can credit KMS integration fees into the POC credit if they pay for it? Customer paid $8k for KMS setup during trial and asked it to be credited.
Sam (Solutions): KMS is a professional services add-on. We usually don't roll PS into product credits, but Finance can approve on a case-by-case.
Kevin (Finance): We can include it if the total ARR commitment exceeds threshold ($200k/yr) and Deal Desk signs off. Otherwise PS remains separate.
Alex (Legal): I'll add a short clause: "PS fees are non-refundable and will only be eligible for credit toward first invoice upon explicit Deal Desk approval documented in the Order Form."
Maria (Sales-Eng): Noted. I'll assemble the Deal Desk packet: POC report, requested credits ($ amount), suggested cap on overage multiplier, and the two legal snips. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Emily (AE): Awesome. Last ask from customer: security questionnaire outstanding — they sent a 40-page infosec packet and are pausing procurement until it's done. Any blockers?
Sam (Solutions): We can handle most answers; security team flagged KMS key stewardship wording and audit retention SLA. We usually provide standard answers but will need Security to sign off on non-standard retention requests.
Alex (Legal): Recommend we provide a response matrix and set expectation: security attestation within 5 business days once Security/TAC has the questionnaire. We should also offer an NDA addendum if they want SOC artifacts shared.
Emily (AE): Great — I'll coordinate the questionnaire handoff to Sam and put a temporary hold on procurement paperwork until we get the signed attestation.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: private-vpc-poc-cluster for acct-9032 on 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC (provisioning window).
Emily (AE): Thanks all — next steps: Maria files Deal Desk packet, Sam leads security Q handoff, Alex drafts clause language into the Order Form, Kevin confirms credit math. I'll follow up in this thread when packets are in. :thumbsup:
